name: Performance and Reliability Testing
purpose: Identify performance, concurrency, reliability, recovery, and availability test scenarios only when supported by the provided requirements or project documentation.

apply_when: The requirement specifies concurrent users or requests.
The requirement specifies endurance or sustained operation.
The requirement explicitly describes performance or reliability expectations.
do_not_apply_when: No performance or reliability behavior is supported by the supplied requirements.
A performance threshold would have to be invented.
A workload would have to be invented.
A concurrency level would have to be invented.
An availability target would have to be invented.
A recovery-time objective would have to be invented.

coverage_dimensions.name: Response-Time Boundary
coverage_dimensions.description: Test at, below, and above an explicitly stated response-time threshold where meaningful.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when an explicit response-time threshold exists.

coverage_dimensions.name: Throughput
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly specified transaction or request throughput.

coverage_dimensions.name: Concurrent Users
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior under an explicitly specified number of concurrent users.

coverage_dimensions.name: Concurrent Requests
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly specified concurrent request behavior.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when concurrent requests are specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Load
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify system behavior under an explicitly defined expected load.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when load characteristics are specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Stress
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior beyond an explicitly stated normal operating limit when such a limit exists.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when a relevant operating limit or stress condition is specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Endurance
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify sustained operation for an explicitly specified duration.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when duration or sustained operation is specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Spike
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify sudden workload changes when spike behavior or workload variation is explicitly relevant.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when workload variation is specified or clearly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Capacity
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly stated capacity limits such as records, users, files, or transactions.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when a capacity constraint is specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Timeout
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when timeout behavior or duration is specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Recovery
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify recovery behavior when recovery requirements are explicitly stated.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when recovery behavior is specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Availability
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify availability requirements when an explicit availability target exists.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when availability requirements are specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Degraded Performance
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined behavior when system performance degrades.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Only when degraded behavior is specified.

threshold_rules.explicit_threshold: Use the exact threshold supplied by the requirement.
threshold_rules.minimum_threshold: Test the stated boundary and meaningful values around it.
threshold_rules.maximum_threshold: Test the stated boundary and meaningful values around it.
threshold_rules.missing_threshold: Report the missing performance criterion instead of inventing one.
threshold_rules.missing_workload: Report the missing workload information instead of inventing it.

examples.requirement: The login response must be returned within 2 seconds.
applicable_scenarios: Login response at or within 2 seconds

examples.requirement: The system must support 100 concurrent users.
applicable_scenarios: Behavior when the stated concurrency capacity is reached

examples.requirement: The system should continue operating during a temporary authentication-service outage.
applicable_scenarios: System behavior during the defined outage condition
Recovery after the dependency becomes available

missing_information.handling: Record the missing criterion as a QA gap and use 'Requires QA Input' when a test field requires the missing value.

unknown_information.rule: Performance and reliability assumptions must never be silently invented.
